metadata.title: ETFs focused on AI stocks are getting pummeled - MarketWatch

content.text:
23 hours ago
ETFs focused on AI stocks are getting pummeled
Exchange-traded funds that buy artificial-intelligence-related stocks were pummeled Thursday amid a heavy selloff in the U.S. stock market’s technology sector.
The iShares AI Innovation and Tech Active ETF, whose top three holdings as of Wednesday were Micron Technology, Nvidia and Advanced Micro Devices, was down more than 6%, according to FactSet data, at last check. The Roundhill Generative AI & Technology ETF was slumping almost 6% on Thursday afternoon.
